subject: CityKey co-marketing credit split for joint webinar recording
messages:
From: Alex Castillo <alex@citykey.io>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Castillo <elena.castillo@eventco.com>
Date: Sun, 08 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Promo codes for CityKey x Redwood webinar recording

Hi Logan & Marissa,

Thanks again for co-hosting the November 2nd webinar — we had ~1.8k signups and the recording is getting request traffic. CityKey would like to gate the recording and offer free trial/promo codes to attendees who register for the on-demand version.

Proposal: CityKey will distribute 1,000 Redwood promo credits for gated access and follow-up nurture. We'd like to split costs 50/50 with Redwood (so 500 credits each) and have a tracking code per partner so we can tie registration conversions back to the joint campaign.

Questions:
- Is Redwood able to provision split promo-code pools and a small CSV export of redemptions?
- Any objections to a 50/50 split or should we propose a different allocation?
- Can you share an expected timeline for code generation and expiration (we want codes valid for 60 days)?

Elena from EventCo (cc'd) will handle gating on the landing page — looping her in in case of format constraints.

Cheers,
Alex Castillo
Head of Partnerships, CityKey
alex@citykey.io

Attachments: none
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 10:08:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Promo codes for CityKey x Redwood webinar recording

Alex — thanks for the note and congrats on the turnout. We can support partner-code pools and a redemption export. High-level:

- Technical: Ops can generate code batches scoped to a campaign ID and export redemption logs (email, timestamp, code).
- Allocation: 50/50 is fine as a starting point; I'd propose we reserve a 10% buffer for ops issues (so request 1,100 total, split 550/550, Redwood caps at 550).
- Expiry: 60 days is standard; we can set a custom expiry per batch.

Next steps: Marissa, can you draft a promo-plan with exact counts + the campaign ID you want in HubSpot? Grace, could you confirm this won't exceed our monthly promo budget for Nov/Dec? Once we have numbers I'll route to finance for final sign-off.

I'll hold on the final go until we have the number and finance OK.

— Logan
